purpose: Steam portrait covers adapted from the user's approved woman-in-foreground key art

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / ads-marketing.
Input image 1 is the approved EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Create ONE portrait Steam store vertical capsule adaptation of this exact cover. Intended final aspect ratio 748:896 (187:224); compose natively for that ratio, ideally a high-resolution 1504x1792 portrait. Do not return multiple panels or a mockup.
Preserve the same recognizable young Chinese woman warrior as the dominant foreground subject, her exact facial identity, black tied-up hair with red ribbon, cream embroidered robe, dark lamellar shoulder armor, red cloak, belt and hand on the sword hilt. Preserve the two smaller male characters behind her: Song Jiang in ochre robes and black headgear, and Lin Chong in dark armor holding a spear. They remain supporting figures behind her and must not replace her as the focal point.
Rearrange only the framing/composition to fit the portrait: large foreground woman occupying the lower center/right, both men clearly readable farther behind; the existing river, Liangshan stockade, reeds, red banner and hazy mountains provide depth. Match the approved fine ink-and-brush historical illustration, aged parchment texture, restrained ochre, ivory, black and deep red, not photographic and not anime.
Place the complete legible gold brush-calligraphy title in a clean black ink area across the upper portion: first line exactly “水浒”, second line exactly “英雄传”. Together these read exactly “水浒英雄传”. Beneath the title, a clearly separate smaller line exactly “八幕战役”. These are the ONLY written words. Keep every character correct, unoccluded, and comfortably inside the canvas with 6 percent safe margins; never clip or abbreviate any character.
The title should remain visually dominant at small Steam thumbnail scale while the woman's unobscured face remains the main character focus. Keep all three faces comfortably within the frame. No borders, no extra logos, no invented characters, no additional weapons, no watermark. This must unmistakably remain the user-selected woman-in-foreground artwork, not a male-led variation.

visual_qa.method: Direct view_image inspection of the native image and the final exact-size export
visual_qa.notes: Gold title and subtitle remain readable at the exported size. The woman is foremost, with two smaller male figures behind her. Text is fully within the canvas; the requested numerical top safe margin was not achieved exactly. Composition was regenerated from the approved reference, not preserved pixel-for-pixel.
